summary: Bain Capital Private Credit filed an 8-K reporting amendments to a loan and security agreement and an increase in a revolving credit facility. The second amendment increased the maximum facility amount from $250M to $400M with an accordion feature up to $450M, reduced the applicable margin from 2.25% to 2.10% per annum, extended the non-call period to February 21, 2027, reinvestment period to August 21, 2028, and maturity to August 21, 2030. Separately, the company increased its SMBC revolving credit facility commitments from $650M to $675M. These are routine financing amendments, not a special situation transaction.
